model.hospital: Heart of the Rockies Regional Medical Center

rules.label: Sliding Scale Income-Based Discount
rules.quote: Financial assistance will be determined on a sliding scale based on family size and family income.

rules.label: Charity Care for Uninsured or Underinsured
rules.quote: HRRMC will provide financial assistance (charity care) to qualified patients who are uninsured or underinsured and do not have the financial means to pay for hospital services.

notes: The policy requires completion of a Financial Assistance Application with all requested household expenses and medical bills, gross income, family size, employment status and future-earning capacity, other financial resources, other financial obligations, dollar amount/frequency/nature of hospital/medical services, three months of bank statements from each contributing to household income, last available W-2 for all family members, most recent four employer paycheck stubs and prior year, state income tax return for the most current or two of the following: most current and prior year's Federal Tax Return, all Financial Assistance applications. Medically necessary services are evaluated on a case-by-case basis at HRRMC's discretion. Non-elective services provided in response to life-threatening circumstances in a non-emergency room setting; emergency medical services provided in an emergency room setting; services for a condition which, if not promptly treated, would lead to an adverse change in the health status of an individual are eligible for charity care. For family units of more than 8 members, add $4,540 for each additional member. Pregnant women count as two people for the purpose of this chart. The policy does not specify timing for application submission, ECA restrictions, or first statement timing. Payment plan terms are not specified.
sliding_scale_discount may leave out a condition: policy requires completion of Financial Assistance application with documentation
uninsured_or_underinsured_charity_care may leave out a condition: policy requires qualification and lack of financial means to pay
